scope: Video operator pipeline, actual subprocess admission/receipts/cancellation, accepted reuse and existing video driver regressions
verification_source: Commands executed in this task; result summary, not a replacement for the original tool output

runs.command: pnpm --filter @understand-book/core exec vitest run video-operator-build external-build-cost video-import video-transcript video-visual-units video-translation video-semantic-series --testTimeout=30000

includes_new_regressions: same-named workspaces retain separate logical call identity
rejected host progress acknowledgment stops the child and preserves its receipt

runs.command: pnpm --filter @understand-book/core exec vitest run video-operator-build -t "different raw MP4"
includes_new_regressions: existing accepted workspace cannot silently replace a different requested raw MP4

operator_scenarios: Admission denied: no child process and no spurious receipt
Successful and failed executions retain returned usage as partial, never a confirmed monetary bill
Spawned failure without usage is unknown; spawn failure is not_sent
Running cancellation stops the child and writes a terminal unknown receipt
Rejected progress acknowledgment stops the child without unhandled rejection and writes a receipt
Terminal receipt retry does not relaunch or re-charge accepted semantic work
Complete original video workspace reuses accepted contributions, including discourse, with no Tutor stage
Two materials named workspace share the parent budget but keep distinct logical call and attempt identities
Different raw MP4 cannot reuse an already accepted unrelated source
limitations: Controlled native MCP executor emits fixture semantics and synthetic usage to verify orchestration; it does not evaluate model understanding quality
External Codex CLI supplies partial token observations, not complete provider monetary receipts
